Importer discovery now builds a reverse dependency index with the shared TypeScript resolver and traverses each reachable caller once using Set membership. The nested loops visit source imports and graph edges, not a Cartesian product of repository files; cycle and child-config regression tests pass.
check-package.ts creates an isolated package-consumer directory with mkdtemp and removes it in finally. temporaryRoot describes scratch storage, not a compatibility path or old consumer.

Intentional public API: package.json exposes coherent/finding from dist/domain/finding.js. serializeFinding is the serialization counterpart to parseFinding. tests/fixtures/packed-package/consumer.ts now imports both through the installed tarball and verifies round-trip behavior; pnpm check:package passed strict consumer types and runtime assertions. Internal test-only usage is expected for this externally exported library surface.

Intentional public API: package.json exposes coherent/finding from dist/domain/finding.js. parseFinding validates persisted serialized findings, including their canonical fingerprint. The packed-package consumer imports it through the public export and round-trips serializeFinding output; pnpm check:package passed strict types and runtime assertions. Preserve this public boundary even though internal production paths accept input through parseFindingInput.

Intentional catalog API: package.json exposes coherent/catalog/rules, including CATEGORIES_BY_ID alongside RULES_BY_ID and RULE_CATEGORIES. The installed packed-package consumer now verifies category lookup for A08, with strict typechecking and runtime assertions passing. This derived lookup is intentionally available to package consumers; internal test-only references do not make it obsolete.

The inner targets.some compares only registrations of the same consumer class within one Nest module for each constructor parameter. It rejects ambiguous bindings; it is not a Cartesian scan of repository files or provider methods. On EPS FinOps, the final static Nest analysis of 834 source files established 304 method uses in 9.03 seconds while validation also ran. No evidence warrants replacing this bounded ambiguity check; retain the fail-closed behavior.
Commander subcommands must be registered on the parent review command before parse. This is a sequential CLI boundary, not independent I/O.
The retry loop waits for an exclusive lock held by another process. Iterations are a lock invariant, not independent I/O that can be parallelized.
Prune classification consumes the audit snapshot and baseline fingerprints before any write. Those reads are prerequisites for the locked update, not independent work.
Read-merge-write must stay inside the exclusive lock so concurrent reviews cannot lose decisions. Parallelizing the write would violate that invariant.
Linear lookup of a batch fingerprint against the current finding list. Input is one audit snapshot, not a growing target-sized collection.
